## Experience
- Heirs Technologies — AI Intern, Software Engineering (Jul–Sep 2026, Lagos). Built AI knowledge retrieval over 2,400+ past tickets for an ITIL 4 service-management platform used by 15 organisations in banking, insurance and energy. Confidence thresholds route each case to answer, private analyst note, or escalation. Wrote 231 automated tests; four-stage rollout behind environment flags. Designed per-department, read-only, fail-closed data access for an AI assistant on an internal risk and audit platform. Stack: NestJS, PostgreSQL + pgvector, Prisma, Redis/BullMQ.
- Platnova — Contract Software Engineer (Aug 2025–Mar 2026, remote). Fintech payments: deposit flows, virtual card issuance, faster transfers; admin platform for KYB compliance, merchant wallets, settlement workflows and audit trails.
- Campor — Co-founder & Frontend Engineer (Oct 2025–present). Live student marketplace at Redeemer's University: listings, Algolia search, Socket.IO messaging, Paystack payments.

## Selected projects
- Fusion — prompt to editable product video (React/Remotion scenes). 2nd of 500+ teams, Interswitch × Enyata Buildathon.
- SeeForMe — real-time spoken navigation for blind and visually impaired users: YOLO v11 + Groq LLM + Web Speech API. 2nd, DATICAN AI in Medicine.
- NairaLedger — payments API with idempotency keys, row-level locking and a retrying settlement queue.
- RUNACOS Platform — 1st place, RUNACOSS Web Design Contest.
- Token Management Hub — ERC-20 tooling on Arbitrum Sepolia (Next.js, Wagmi, RainbowKit). Arbitrum Builders Bounty winner.
